responsibility: This file implements mc’s target-language name hygiene and generated-header tracking for C and C++ output. It maintains keyword, macro, and scope symbol tables to detect clashes and produce mangled alternatives, tracks which runtime helpers, library functions, types, limits macros, and headers have been referenced, and emits the corresponding #include and declaration prologue through mcPretty. It is the bridge between decl’s abstract symbol names and legally usable generated C/C++ identifiers.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the executable implementation for the keyc stem: it maintains internal keyword and macro symbol trees, scope records, seen-* dependency flags, and name-mangling logic, while the same-named .def file only declares those services.
